text:
Type: small square solid pine coffee table
Use: holding drinks, books and plants; living room, cabin, kids' room
Style: rustic, Scandinavian, farmhouse
Materials: untreated solid pine with visible knots and grain
Colors: pale natural pine, light warm wood
Shape: square plank top with a simple apron, four straight square legs, sturdy and plain, compact and fairly tall for its type
Feel: natural, honest, warm, simple
Goes with: white walls, linen and wool textiles, other natural woods; cabins, rustic or Scandinavian living rooms

product.name: NORNS
product.description: Untreated solid pine is a durable natural material that can be painted, oiled or stained according to preference.
